name: Elkanah
description: Levite living at the time of United Monarchy

points: Elkanah her husband said to her, Hannah, why weepest thou? and why eatest thou not? and why is thy heart grieved? am not I better to thee than ten sons?

note.label: 1 Samuel 1: Hannah's Vow and the Birth of Samuel

points: They rose up in the morning early, worshipped before the Lord, and returned to their house to Ramah; they went back up north, for Elkanah came out of mount Ephraim. And Elkanah knew Hannah his wife: knew means he laid with her, they had laid down together; and the Lord remembered her.

note.label: 1 Samuel 1: Hannah's Vow and the Birth of Samuel

points: The man Elkanah, and all his house, went up to offer unto the Lord the yearly sacrifice, and his vow. What is that yearly sacrifice going into? Deuteronomy 16:16.

note.label: 1 Samuel 1: Hannah's Vow and the Birth of Samuel

points: Elkanah said unto her, Do what seemeth thee good; tarry until thou have weaned him; only the Lord establish his word. She did not have to go up: the law said all thy males. So the woman abode, and gave her son suck until she weaned him.

note.label: 1 Samuel 1: Hannah's Vow and the Birth of Samuel

points: Elkanah went to Ramah to his house, and the child did minister unto the Lord before Eli the priest. Now the sons of Eli were sons of Belial; they knew not the Lord. They were the devil.

note.label: 1 Samuel 2: By Him Actions Are Weighed
